description:
Zomi Translator is the free, fast way to translate between Zomi and English. No sign-in needed.

INSTANT ZOMI WORDS
• Dictionary words appear the moment you type, straight from a verified Zomi dictionary of more than 33,000 entries
• Works offline: the full Zomi dictionary lives on your device
• Search in Zomi or English, with or without tone marks, and even with a small typo

FAST, ACCURATE SENTENCES
• Sentences start appearing in about a second
• Every translation is checked against the verified Zomi dictionary, so common terms stay consistent
• Clear, natural Zomi that follows standard spelling and grammar

MADE FOR EVERY DAY
• Swap Zomi and English with one tap
• History with search, favorites, swipe to delete, and Clear all
• Share a translation as a beautiful image or as text
• Copy with one tap

FREE FOR EVERYONE
• Dictionary words are always free and unlimited
• Sentences are free up to a generous daily amount on each device
• Optional sign-in with Apple or Google for unlimited translation and history that syncs between your devices

WORKS EVERYWHERE
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a side-by-side layout on larger screens
• Also available on Android and on the web at zomitranslator.com

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads and no tracking
• Dictionary lookups never leave your device
• Delete your history or your account at any time in Settings

Translations of sentences are produced by AI and may contain mistakes. For important documents, please ask a fluent speaker to review.

Questions or suggestions? Email support@zomitranslator.com
